title: Trump to Julius Caesar in just four pictures
description: A White House handshake, a Hollywood marriage and an earthquake visit connect Donald Trump to Julius Caesar.
hook: How is Donald Trump connected to Julius Caesar?

links.line: In 1987, a young Donald Trump shook President Ronald Reagan's hand at a White House reception.

image.file: File:Formal Engagement Photograph of Ronald Reagan and Nancy Davis - DPLA - 152c17bc0721ccd2fb0d1b9282cd7620.jpg

links.line: Back in 1952, Hollywood actor Ronald Reagan married actress Nancy Davis, the future First Lady.

image.file: File:Nancy Reagan Visits Mexico City with Ambassador John Gavin After The Earthquake - DPLA - 5d1211646d7bc088f9908cfadc641730.jpg

links.line: In 1985, Nancy toured Mexico City's earthquake ruins with the US ambassador, former movie star John Gavin.
And in the 1960 epic Spartacus, Gavin played the young Julius Caesar.
